properties.comment:
MTPASA_INTERCONNECTORSOLUTION is obsolete from 2017 End of Year DM4.27 Release. 
The MTPASA_INTERCONNECTORSOLUTION table shows the results of the capacity evaluation for Interconnectors, including the calculated limits for the ldcblock within the day.
Change Notice 379 announced the replacement of the MT PASA data model so all MTPASAxxx tables become obsolete, replaced by MTPASA_xxx tables (see Change Notices 400, 400a and 400b).

fields.doc: Date processing of the run begins
fields.name: RUN_DATETIME

fields.doc: Unique run id. Generated from the solution file caseid
fields.name: RUN_NO

fields.doc: Sunday at start of the week for this solutions energy block. Generated from the solution file energy block
fields.name: ENERGYBLOCK

fields.doc: Day this solution is for. Generated from the solution file periodid
fields.name: DAY

fields.doc: LDC block this solution is for. Generated from the solution file periodid
fields.name: LDCBLOCK

fields.doc: The unique identifier for the interconnector
fields.name: INTERCONNECTORID

fields.doc: Interconnector loading level (MW) that can be reached in case of capacity scarcity in neighbouring regions subject to network and energy constraints
fields.name: CAPACITYMWFLOW

fields.doc: Capacity adequacy assessment marginal value; 0 if not binding
fields.name: CAPACITYMARGINALVALUE

fields.doc: Capacity adequacy assessment violation degree, 0 if not violating; where CapacityMWFLow <= export + violation Degree (Deficit)CapacityMWFLow >= import + CapacityViolationDegree (Deficit)
fields.name: CAPACITYVIOLATIONDEGREE

fields.doc: Calculated Interconnector limit of exporting energy on the basis of invoked constraints and static interconnector export limit
fields.name: CALCULATEDEXPORTLIMIT

fields.doc: Calculated Interconnector limit of importing energy on the basis of invoked constraints and static interconnector import limit. Note unlike the input interconnector import limit this is a directional quantity and should be defined with respect to the interconnector flow
fields.name: CALCULATEDIMPORTLIMIT

fields.doc: Type of run.  Values are RELIABILITY_LRC and OUTAGE_LRC
fields.name: RUNTYPE

fields.doc: ID of the constraint that sets the Interconnector Export Limit
fields.name: EXPORTLIMITCONSTRAINTID

fields.doc: ID of the constraint that sets the Interconnector Import Limit
fields.name: IMPORTLIMITCONSTRAINTID
